newsitem.title: NORWAY: Aker Maritime in 480 mln NOK offshore deal.
newsitem.headline: Aker Maritime in 480 mln NOK offshore deal.

text.p: Norway's Aker Maritime ASA said on Wednesday it had signed a letter of intent to supply equipment to the Asgaard B platform operated by Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil).
Aker Maritime said the deal was won by its subsidiary Aker Engineering and was worth about 480 million crowns.

Under the letter of intent, Aker Engineering will provide the compressor module for Asgaard B, a semi-submersible natural gas platform to be towed into position off mid-Norway in the year 2000, a statement said.
Work on the module project will begin immediately and the equipment will be delievered in April 1999, it said.
Aker Engineering is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Aker Maritime.
